title: Internal memo: Amazon is replacing white-collar job titles at its Ring and Blink units with the designation "builder", and "builder leaders" for managers (Greg Bensinger/Reuters)
summary: Greg Bensinger / Reuters: Internal memo: Amazon is replacing white-collar job titles at its Ring and Blink units with the designation “builder”, and “builder leaders” for managers — During Amazon's (AMZN.O) annual review season now under way, hundreds of employees will see their job titles stripped.
contentText:
Greg Bensinger / Reuters :

Internal memo: Amazon is replacing white-collar job titles at its Ring and Blink units with the designation “builder”, and “builder leaders” for managers   —  During Amazon's (AMZN.O) annual review season now under way, hundreds of employees will see their job titles stripped.
